audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Sermon opening: makarioi, poor in spirit, meek/gentle, righteousness/justice hunger, mercy, pure heart, peacemakers, Torah fulfillment, anger, Gehenna, reconciliation, lust/desire, divorce, oaths, retaliation, and enemy-love.

verses.restored: Seeing the crowds, Jesus went up into the mountain; and when he sat down, his disciples came to him.

familiar.text: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

verses.restored: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying:

familiar.text: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the reign of the heavens.

familiar.text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

familiar.text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are the gentle/meek, for they will inherit the earth.

familiar.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness/justice, for they will be filled.

familiar.text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are the merciful, for they will receive mercy.

familiar.text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are the pure in heart, for they will see the Divine.

familiar.text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons/children of the Divine.

familiar.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are those persecuted because of righteousness/justice, for theirs is the reign of the heavens.

familiar.text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing are you when people insult you, persecute you, and say every evil thing against you falsely because of me.

familiar.text: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

verses.restored: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in the heavens; for in this way they persecuted the prophets before you.

familiar.text: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

verses.restored: You are the salt of the earth; but if salt becomes tasteless, with what will it be salted? It is no longer strong for anything except to be thrown outside and trampled by people.

familiar.text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

verses.restored: You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.

familiar.text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

verses.restored: Nor do they light a lamp and place it under a basket, but on the lampstand, and it shines for all in the house.

familiar.text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

verses.restored: In the same way, let your light shine before people, so they may see your beautiful/good works and give glory to your Father in the heavens.

familiar.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

verses.restored: Do not think that I came to dissolve the Law or the Prophets; I did not come to dissolve but to fulfill.

familiar.text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

verses.restored: Amen, I say to you: until heaven and earth pass away, not one iota or one stroke will pass from the Law until all comes to be.

familiar.text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

verses.restored: Therefore whoever loosens one of the least of these commands and teaches people so will be called least in the reign of the heavens; but whoever does and teaches them will be called great in the reign of the heavens.

familiar.text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.restored: For I say to you: unless your righteousness/justice exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will certainly not enter the reign of the heavens.

familiar.text: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.restored: You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, You shall not murder; and whoever murders will be liable to judgment.

familiar.text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

verses.restored: But I say to you that everyone angry with a brother or sister will be liable to judgment; whoever says to a brother or sister, Empty-head, will be liable to the council; and whoever says, Fool, will be liable to the Gehenna of fire.

familiar.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

verses.restored: Therefore if you bring your gift to the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,

familiar.text: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

verses.restored: leave your gift there before the altar, go first and be reconciled to your brother or sister, and then come offer your gift.

familiar.text: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

verses.restored: Be well-disposed quickly toward your accuser while you are with him on the way, lest the accuser hand you to the judge, the judge to the officer, and you be thrown into prison.

familiar.text: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

verses.restored: Amen, I say to you: you will certainly not come out from there until you have paid the last quadrans.

familiar.text: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

verses.restored: You have heard that it was said, You shall not commit adultery.

familiar.text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

verses.restored: But I say to you that everyone looking at a woman in order to desire/covet her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

familiar.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

verses.restored: If your right eye causes you to stumble, remove it and throw it from you; for it is better for one part of you to perish than for your whole body to be thrown into Gehenna.

familiar.text: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

verses.restored: And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it from you; for it is better for one part of you to perish than for your whole body to go into Gehenna.

familiar.text: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

verses.restored: It was also said: Whoever releases his wife, let him give her a document of release.

familiar.text: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

verses.restored: But I say to you that everyone releasing his wife, except for sexual unfaithfulness, makes her be adulterized; and whoever marries a released woman commits adultery.

familiar.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

verses.restored: Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones: You shall not swear falsely, but shall give back to the Lord your oaths.

familiar.text: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

verses.restored: But I say to you not to swear at all: neither by heaven, because it is the throne of the Divine,

familiar.text: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:

verses.restored: nor by the earth, because it is the footstool of his feet, nor by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.

familiar.text: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

verses.restored: Nor shall you swear by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

verses.restored: Let your word be yes, yes; no, no. What exceeds these comes from the evil/harmful one.

familiar.text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

verses.restored: You have heard that it was said: Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.

familiar.text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

verses.restored: But I say to you not to violently resist the evil/harmful person; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

familiar.text: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

verses.restored: To the one wanting to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak also.

familiar.text: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.

verses.restored: Whoever compels you for one mile, go with him two.

familiar.text: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

verses.restored: Give to the one asking you, and do not turn away from the one wanting to borrow from you.

familiar.text: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

verses.restored: You have heard that it was said: You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.

familiar.text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

verses.restored: But I say to you: love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

familiar.text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

verses.restored: so that you may become children of your Father in the heavens, because he makes his sun rise on evil and good and sends rain on righteous and unrighteous.

familiar.text: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

verses.restored: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?

familiar.text: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

verses.restored: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing? Do not even the nations do the same?

familiar.text: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

verses.restored: Therefore you shall be complete/whole, as your heavenly Father is complete/whole.

familiar.text: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
